Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.checkpoint

Class VersionedMemorySaver

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.checkpoint.VersionedMemorySaver
All Implemented Interfaces:
BaseCheckpointSaver, HasVersions
public class VersionedMemorySaver extends Object implements BaseCheckpointSaver, HasVersions
VersionedMemorySaver is a class that implements BaseCheckpointSaver and HasVersions. It provides methods to save checkpoints with versioning and retrieve them based on thread IDs and versions. Experimental feature
